meta_description:
350 likes, 6 comments - delish on October 26, 2026: "You'll never want to try another pasta after @lisavanderpump's Shrimp Pasta 🍤

Lisa Vanderpump—restaurateur, entrepreneur, The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills icon, and star of Vanderpump Rules—joins Cooking With Friends to make her famous Shrimp Pasta from her cookbook, Home at Villa Rosa. She shares the story behind the recipe, why it’s one of her husband Ken Todd’s favorites, and what it’s like cooking and entertaining at Villa Rosa.

Watch the full video at the link in bio.".
